body: Pre-registered (research_notes/Decision audits/card_fixes_historical_test.md section A, saved before computing). Leave-one-cohort-out: each firm gets a card-shaped forecast (bear .25@0.65M, base .5@M, bull .2@1.45M, blow-up .05@0.1x; M, base rates, sigma_class from the other cohorts). 5-bin log score (India non-fin / lenders / US): V0 (sigma .35, left-only anchoring) -1.760/-3.075/-1.750; sigma_class -1.626/-1.965/-1.582; two-sided -1.660/-2.519/-1.632. Sum Brier delta: sigma -0.0104/+0.0120/-0.0097 -> FAILS guard on lenders (P<=0.5x overshoots 28.9% vs 25.2%); two-sided -0.0110/+0.0002/-0.0053 -> PASSES historical half (adoption still needs near-term live calls to 30-Sep-2027 not worse). sigma .35 too narrow: 50%/80% intervals caught 35/60% (India), 12/53% (lenders), 33/65% (US). P(blow-up) under-predicted in every variant (10.5 vs 15.5%, 16.3 vs 27.1%, 10.1 vs 15.3%). Live cards (in memory, none re-issued): with fix 3 only HARSHA opens (EV 1.87x vs 1.76x, 4% cap); SUNFLAG's 1% under fix 3 is an artefact of its deprecated survivor class (0 on india_nonfin). SHK fix-3 EV falls because 5-pt Gauss-Hermite over-weights >=3x (22.7% vs 13.6% continuous) -> a fix-3 patch needs a finer grid. Fix 1 (mult5 = median; gate = distribution mean) and fix 5 (bear>bull shape warning) written as tools/decision/patches/v1.6_fix1_mean_median_fix5_shape_warning.patch, not applied; under v1.6 EVs rise 5-8%, no card opens, 7/8 get the shape warning.

verdict.fix3_two_sided: passes historical half; pending live-call condition

title: Card fixes (3) two-sided anchoring and (4) sigma on historical panels: fix 3 passes, fix 4 fails the pre-registered Brier guard (lenders)
